item.title: Be Bold Media : Rights x Tech
item.description: Rights x Tech is a forum for technologists, policy experts, and movement leaders to discuss emerging issues around human rights, technology, and power. We seek to explicitly explore intersections and to connect community focused on incorporating principles of human rights into technology facilitating daily civic life
